root.label: array, bitset, vector<bool>
root.note: Fixed-size and bit-packed containers, and why vector<bool> is odd.

children.label: std::array
children.note: An aggregate wrapping T[N].

children.label: Aggregate initialization
children.note: No constructors; missing initializers are value-initialized, and a bare local is indeterminate.

children.label: Brace elision
children.note: array<int,3> a{1,2,3} works without inner braces; extra initializers are ill-formed.

children.label: Zero size
children.note: begin() equals end(); front() and back() are undefined; data() may be null.

children.label: to_array (C++20)
children.note: Deduces size from a built-in array or list and can convert elements; CTAD cannot.

children.label: Value-like behaviour
children.note: Copies, compares and swaps elementwise.

children.label: Linear swap
children.note: swap exchanges elements one by one, unlike pointer-based containers.

children.label: Structural and tuple-like
children.note: Usable as an NTTP and with structured bindings.

children.label: std::bitset
children.note: N bits fixed at compile time, no iterators.

children.label: Bit 0 is least significant
children.note: The rightmost string character is bit 0; to_string prints the high bit first.

children.label: Integer constructor truncates
children.note: Only the low N bits of the integer are kept.

children.label: to_ulong overflow
children.note: Throws overflow_error when the value does not fit, regardless of N.

children.label: Checked and unchecked access
children.note: test and set throw out_of_range; operator[] is undefined out of range.

children.label: vector<bool> proxy
children.note: operator[] returns a class, not bool&.

children.label: auto captures a proxy
children.note: auto x = v[0] aliases the element; write bool x for a snapshot.

children.label: No address or auto&
children.note: &v[0], bool& and for (auto& b : v) do not compile; auto&& does.

children.label: flip and no data()
children.note: v.flip() flips all bits, v[i].flip() one; there is no data().

children.label: vector<bool> guarantees
children.note: What the standard does and does not say.

children.label: Packing not mandated
children.note: Bit packing is the motivation but not a requirement; all major libraries pack.

children.label: Data races
children.note: Adjacent elements written by different threads race, unlike other vectors.

children.label: Iterator category
children.note: Models C++20 random_access_iterator but not Cpp17 forward iterator.

children.label: Alternatives
children.note: Pick by what you need from the elements.

children.label: Real references needed
children.note: Use vector<char> or vector<uint8_t>.

children.label: Fixed width
children.note: Use bitset<N>, which may exceed any integer width.
